newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 9.

text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Monday's Sri Lankan newspapers.
Police arrest Tamil Tiger suicide bomber in north central Anuradhapura, whose mission was to attack the Sri Maha Bodhi, a sacred Buddhist shrine.
Justice Minister, G.L.Peiris says if a political solution to northeast conflict fails, only beneficiary will be the LTTE.
Legislation soon to combat problems of money laundering, says Justice Minister G.P. Peiris. His ministry is working on details of bill to be presented to parliament in November.
U.S. investors interested to build airport, tourist complex near soutehrn port city of Galle, says Navin Gooneratne, Chairman, Southern Development Authority.
Police arrest separatist rebel on his way to stage attack at Sri Maha Bodhi in Anuradhapura.
Two members of the visiting Zimbabwe cricket team rescued from rough seas by life guards of southern Ahungalle Triton Hotel.
Office in Colombo shortly to issue national identity cards to displaced people now in Colombo.
Police arrest suicide bomber on his way to stage attack at Anuradhapura.
Indian Foreign Minister soon in Colombo to discuss problem of Tamil refugees in Tamil Nadu.
